sentences.text: 3.However, the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that no notice has been issued so far after the impugned seizure memo was issued seizing HANS  CHHAP TABACCO of 900 Kg under 25 number of bags.
The seizure has been effected under Section 38 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
After the seizure was effected, notice has to be issued.
No notice has been issued so far.

3.The present Writ Petition is disposed with liberty to the petitioner to initiate appropriate proceedings after ascertaining the status of seized HANS  CHHAP TABACCO.
No cost.
